title: Modular Buildings & Restroom Rental with Ancillary Services
agency: TRANSPORTATION, DEPARTMENT OF > FEDERAL HIGHWAY ADMINISTRATION > 690567 WESTERN FEDERAL LANDS DIV
description:
This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or commercial services prepared in accordance with FAR 12.201 Solicitation procedures.  This announcement constitutes the only solicitation.  Quotations are being requested and a written solicitation will not be issued. 

 Solicitation number 69056727Q000005 is issued as an (RFQ) for Modular Buildings & Restroom Rental with Ancillary Services.  This requirement is to support and maintain WFLHD operations during the Division Office Facility Renovation by obtaining prefabricated modular office building(s), single-wide container/modular office units, and an executive restroom trailer on a temporary lease basis, including professional delivery, site preparation, installation, utility connection, preventative maintenance, weekly septic pumping maintenance, technical troubleshooting support, and eventual teardown/demobilization. 

 Additional information as required in FAR 12.202(b)(1) is provided in the RFQ document attached herein. 

 This acquisition is UNRESTRICTED FULL & OPEN and incorporates provisions and clauses by reference.  The full text of  provisions and clauses may be accessed electronically at https://www.acquisition.gov/faroverhaul/far-part-deviation-guide/far-overhaul-part-52.  The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 532490 with an industry size standard of $40.0 million and the associated Product Service Code (PSC) is W054. 

 All interested vendors shall refer to Section E for full-text FAR Provision 52.212-1, Instructions to Offerors, and its Addendum.
